d: Senior mechanical / technical role that requires employee to handle field-based mechanical installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and repair activities across operational sites.
q: Diploma, HND, Associate Degree, or Technical Certification in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, or related discipline.
Minimum 8-10 years of experience performing major maintenance activities on natural gas engines and reciprocating compressors
Extensive experience in a workshop environment performing hands on mechanical overhauls in Waukesha VHP series engines, diesel engines and Ariel compressors is a must
Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, rotating equipment and maintenance best practices.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and manuals.
Experience in precision measurement instruments to determine engine components condition and knowledge on usage of machine cleaning equipment and processes
Strong knowledge of assembly and dismantling of internal combustion engines and reciprocating gas compressors
Field-based role requiring travel to operational or project sites.
May involve working outdoors in varying weather conditions.
Ability to work shifts, weekends, overtime, and emergency callouts.
Must be physically capable of lifting equipment, climbing ladders, and standing for extended periods.
r: li

li

Comply with all Enerflex HR, Quality, HSE, and all the Company policies, procedures, processes, work instructions and guidelines

Perform all other duties as assigned by Supervisor / Manager
